newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end erratic trading mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end erratic trading mixed.

text.p: U.S. debt futures ended erratic trading mixed, with an late rebound losing strength in the long end, which sagged back to small losses.

Market talk, later confirmed, of a 1.1-percent increase in the Lynch, Jones & Ryan weekly Redbook retail sales index, coupled with a technical stallout, helped sap an afternoon rally of strength, brokers said.
"I think with Redbook being up a little bit, people got caught a little long at the top and we got some liquidation," said one T-bond futures broker of the final slippage to the downside.
